_sources: Specification: Harley-Davidson's own spec tables, https://www.harley-davidson.com/eu/en/motorcycles/2025/cvo-road-glide-st.html and https://www.harley-davidson.com/gb/en/motorcycles/cvo-road-glide-st.html (EC 134/2014 figures, checked 2026-11-21). The 2025 and 2026 tables carry the same engine, power, torque and weight. No year on the page: the photographed bike's year is not confirmed, and its red and black paint is not a 2026 colour. No colour palette for the same reason, so the form falls back to free-text colour. Photos: Providence Auto's own (Content/Bikes); no number plate is fitted.
engineConfig: Milwaukee-Eight 121 High Output V-twin, Electronic Sequential Port Fuel Injection
infotainment: Skyline OS on a 312 mm full-colour TFT screen, Apple CarPlay, 125 W per channel fairing audio
features: 47 mm inverted fork with adjustable preload, compression and rebound damping
Rear suspension with adjustable preload, compression and rebound damping
Dual floating front rotors with radially mounted four-piston calipers
Cornering Enhanced ABS, Traction Control and Drag-Torque Slip Control
Vehicle Hold Control and tyre pressure monitoring
Eight ride modes, including Track and Track+
Black 7-spoke cast aluminium wheels, 19-inch front and 18-inch rear

The figures on this page are Harley-Davidson's published specification for the current model.
